reason: Original CA Recheck re-reads exact descriptor/CA bytes and rejects removed/changed input. A memory observation plus SQL clock alone cannot prove immutable material or current revocation; dropping that check would change source semantics.
source_boundary: C1 forbids file/provider I/O under locks; retain old legacy Recheck unchanged. Require independently authenticated original immutable-version/lifecycle and current revocation facts through the original trusted authority before claiming equivalent narrow-SQL material admission.
nonce_also_affected: Original nonce Recheck reads all original active/retained descriptor/material bytes, so its candidate adapter must address the same current-material truth source in addition to the global lock prefix.
